part.text: Found the bug. In `getPagesInSection` (hugolib/content_map_page.go:390), `otherBranch` only tracks the *last* branch seen, so when `/s1-foo` sorts before `/s1/p1` in the radix walk, the child-branch skip check uses the wrong prefix and `/s1/p1`, `/s1/p2` leak into the non-recursive listing. Let me verify how keys look before fixing:

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `pageMap.getPagesInSection` (hugolib/content_map_page.go:390): during a non-recursive walk of the page tree, the code only remembered the **last** child branch it encountered (`otherBranch`). Since the radix tree walks keys in lexicographic order, `/s1-foo/...` sorts before `/s1/p1`, overwriting `otherBranch` with `/s1-foo/` — so `/s1/p1` and `/s1/p2` failed the prefix check and leaked into the parent section's `.Pages` collection when an adjacent section shared a name prefix.

The fix tracks **all** child-branch prefixes seen during the walk (`otherBranches []string`) and skips any key matching any of them.

Verification:
- The issue's failing test case (s1/s1-foo with p1/p2) now yields `__|s1|s1-foo|__` on the home page and correct local `.Pages` for each section.
- Full `./hugolib/...`, `./resources/page/...`, and `./hugolib/doctree/...` test suites pass; gofmt/vet clean.
